title: rhinanthus vernalis
intro: Rhinanthus vernalis, commonly known as Early Spring Cuckooflower, is a flowering plant belonging to the family Orobanchaceae. This hemiparasitic plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine, offering various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties.
